newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra to issue 400 bln rupiah bond.
newsitem.headline: Astra to issue 400 bln rupiah bond.

text.p: Indonesia's biggest vehicle manufacturer PT Astra International said on Wednesday it planned to offer a 400 billion rupiah bond issue in January to refinance short-term debt.
Astra's finance director Rini Suwandi told a public meeting the bond would mature in the year 2000, but she said no decision had been made on the interest rate.
"We are still in discussions but we plan to finalise the interest rate in early January," she said.
Suwandi said the company would use the proceeds to refinance short-term debt to enhance its debt maturity profile.
Astra had set a tentative schedule on the bond issue but was still awaiting final approval from the Stock Exchange Supervisory Agency (Bapepam), she said.
The company said it had proposed January 15 to 17 for the public offer period.
Suwandi said that under the proposed schedule the bonds would be listed on the Surabaya Stock Exchanges on January 29.
Astra International issued a $200 million Eurobond last July which was also used to refinance short-term debt.
